q: How long does a website take?
a: Most business websites take four to eight weeks from kick-off to launch. Ecommerce and custom platforms take longer. You’ll get a dated plan in the proposal, and a weekly update while we build.

Because two ‘websites’ can differ by ten times in scope. We’d rather understand what you need and give you one clear, fixed quote than a range that means nothing. Use the estimator and you’ll have it within 24 hours.

q: Will I own my website and brand files?
a: Yes. Once the project is paid, the code, designs, logos and accounts are yours. We set everything up in your name from day one.

q: Do you work with businesses outside Dhaka?
a: Yes. We work with clients across Bangladesh and abroad. Meetings happen on call or video, and we’re happy to visit for kick-offs and shoots.
Every project includes 30 days of free support. After that, most clients keep us on a monthly plan for updates, security, marketing or all three.

q: What happens after I send an enquiry?
a: A senior team member calls you within one business day for a 15-minute chat. If it’s a fit, we send a proposal with a fixed price and timeline. No pressure, no endless follow-ups.
